# Social-platform logo assets

The six SVG paths are copied unchanged from Simple Icons npm package 15.14.0: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, Telegram, and YouTube. Source library: https://simpleicons.org/ and https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons . The package license/disclaimer are included alongside these assets when provided by the package. Brand trademarks and usage restrictions remain those of their respective owners; library CC0 status does not grant an endorsement or authorization to use a service improperly.
